en.naslov_strani: Wayfare Studio — Raw footage in, vlog out
en.opis: Wayfare Studio turns your travel clips into a finished vlog, ready to post. Claude edits, you decide. Free for Mac, Windows and Android.
en.hero_uvod: Wayfare Studio turns your travel clips into a finished vlog, ready to post. Claude edits, you decide.
en.okno_oznaka: The Wayfare Studio editor, assembling piece by piece
en.k0_opis: Drop them in straight from the camera or phone.
en.k1_opis: Sorted by the time you shot it. The story of your day, found for you.
en.k2_opis: Change anything with one sentence. No timeline to wrestle.
en.k3_opis: A built-in library by country and mood. It ducks under every word.
en.k4_opis: Place cards with local time, a trailer of the best moments and a real 3D map of your route.
en.k5_opis: Over twenty-five checks — loudness, cuts, captions — with one-click fixes.
en.k6_opis: Publish straight to YouTube, TikTok and Instagram — title, description and tags written for you.
en.claude_opis: Open the Claude panel next to the timeline, paste your Anthropic API key and say what you want. Claude edits with the app's own tools; you see every step and undo it with ⌘Z. You pay Anthropic only for what you use.

en.zasebnost_opis: What we keep about signed-in members and why.
en.zasebnost_uvod: You can browse without signing in and without cookies. Here is what we store if you sign up for updates.
en.zasebnost_1_besedilo: Your email, name and profile picture (if you come via Google), your language and which updates you want, when you signed up, when you last visited, how many times, and which films you started watching on the site, and the comments you write (visible to every visitor with your name and profile picture, never your email). Nothing else.
en.zasebnost_2_besedilo: To email you when a new film or a new version of Wayfare Studio is out, and to know how many people come back. We don't sell or share the data.
en.zasebnost_3_besedilo: The data lives in a database at Cloudflare, which also hosts this site. Email is sent through Brevo. Google sign-in happens at Google; we receive only your email, name and picture, and Google receives nothing from us.
en.zasebnost_4_besedilo: For as long as you have an account. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe link at the bottom. You can delete your account and all data yourself in Settings (the menu with your name at the top of the page).
en.zasebnost_5_besedilo: One cookie (wayfare_seja) keeps you signed in for a year; it's set only when you sign in. Your browser also remembers your language choice. There are no third-party cookies.
en.zasebnost_6_besedilo: For signed-in members we record the time of the last visit, the number of visits and which films they started watching. For everyone else we only count how many times a day the site loads, without cookies and without identifying anyone.
en.racun_izbrisi_vprasanje: Delete your account? All your data goes and you won't get any more updates.
en.zasebnost_7_besedilo: Wayfare Studio works on your computer. Only what you start goes online: music, transcription models and map data you download, place names you look up (OpenStreetMap), and videos you publish — those go straight to YouTube, TikTok or Instagram under your own account; the sign-in tokens stay on your computer. One thing is prepared in advance: when you open a project whose clips have GPS, the map for the 3D route (map tiles, roads and rail tracks along the route, the list of airports) downloads in the background, so the 3D route is ready when you open it. Only the area of the route is sent, never your clips; you can switch this off under Privacy (“Map in advance”). If you use Claude, your messages, clip descriptions and the thumbnails Claude looks at go to Anthropic under your own API key, as described in Anthropic's terms. The clips themselves stay on your computer, and so does the key. With “Offline” on (Privacy, in the ⋯ menu) the app goes online for nothing at all.
en.cilj_uvod: Version {{razlicica}} is free, with no subscription. Your clips stay on your computer until you publish.
en.zasebnost_8_besedilo: The Companion page keeps your marks, notes, places and voice notes only on your phone. They leave it only as a file you send yourself to your Mac; we never receive them.

sl.zasebnost_1_besedilo: E-naslov, ime in sliko profila (če prideš z Googlom), izbrani jezik in katera obvestila želiš, čas prijave, čas zadnjega obiska strani, število obiskov in katere filme si začel gledati na strani ter komentarje, ki jih napišeš (vidni so vsem obiskovalcem, z imenom in sliko profila, brez e-naslova). Nič drugega.
sl.zasebnost_2_besedilo: Da ti pošljemo e-pošto, ko objavimo nov film ali novo različico aplikacije Wayfare Studio, in da vemo, koliko ljudi se vrača. Podatkov ne prodajamo in jih ne dajemo naprej.
sl.zasebnost_3_besedilo: Podatki so v bazi pri Cloudflaru, ki gosti tudi stran. Pošto pošilja Brevo. Prijava z Googlom teče pri Googlu; od njega dobimo le e-naslov, ime in sliko, Google pa od nas nič.
sl.zasebnost_4_besedilo: Dokler imaš račun. S povezavo na dnu vsake pošte se odjaviš z enim klikom. Račun in vse podatke izbrišeš sam v Nastavitvah (meni z imenom v glavi strani).
sl.zasebnost_5_besedilo: En piškotek (wayfare_seja) te drži prijavljenega eno leto; nastavi se šele ob prijavi. Brskalnik si zapomni še izbrani jezik. Piškotkov tretjih ni.
sl.zasebnost_6_besedilo: Prijavljenim članom zapišemo čas zadnjega obiska, število obiskov in katere filme so začeli gledati. Za vse obiskovalce štejemo le, kolikokrat na dan se stran naloži, brez piškotkov in brez prepoznavanja posameznika.
sl.racun_izbrisi_vprasanje: Izbrišem tvoj račun? Vsi tvoji podatki izginejo in obvestil ne dobiš več.
sl.zasebnost_7_besedilo: Wayfare Studio dela na tvojem računalniku. Na splet gre le, kar začneš sam: prenosi glasbe, modelov za prepis in podatkov za zemljevide, imena krajev, ki jih poiščeš (OpenStreetMap), in videi, ki jih objaviš — ti gredo naravnost na YouTube, TikTok ali Instagram s tvojim računom; žetoni prijave ostanejo na tvojem računalniku. Eno se pripravi vnaprej: ko odpreš projekt, katerega posnetki imajo GPS, se v ozadju prenese zemljevid za 3D pot (ploščice zemljevida, ceste in tiri ob poti, seznam letališč), da je 3D pot pripravljena, ko jo odpreš. Gre le območje poti, posnetki nikoli; izklopiš v Zasebnosti (»Zemljevid vnaprej«). Če uporabljaš Clauda, gredo tvoja sporočila, opisi posnetkov in sličice, ki si jih Claude ogleda, k Anthropicu s tvojim ključem API, po Anthropicovih pogojih. Posnetki sami ostanejo na računalniku, prav tako ključ. Z vklopljenim »Brez spleta« (Zasebnost v meniju ⋯) aplikacija ne gre na splet za nič.
sl.cilj_uvod: Različica {{razlicica}} je zastonj, brez naročnine. Posnetki ostanejo na tvojem računalniku, dokler ne objaviš.
sl.zasebnost_8_besedilo: Stran Spremljevalec hrani oznake, opombe, kraje in glasovne zapiske le na tvojem telefonu. Z njega gredo le kot datoteka, ki jo sam pošlješ na svoj Mac; mi je nikoli ne dobimo.
